props.gloss_en: Mar Zutra: the halakha follows all these teachings, in the case of one who forgets
Rav Ashi: even one who forgets -- no
Rav Ashi: they said 'a loaf or a baby' only for a corpse
Abaye would put a spoon on bundles
Rava would put a knife on a young dove and move it
Rav Yosef: granted the Rabbis said it of one who forgets -- did they say it ab initio?
Abaye: were I not an important person, why would I need a spoon on the bundles?
Abaye: [the bundles] are themselves fit to lean on
Rava: were I not an important person, why would I need a knife on a young dove?
Rava: [the young dove] is fit for me as raw meat
Rava to his attendant: roast me a duck, and throw its innards to the cat
Rava expounded: a woman may not enter the woodshed to take a poker from it
Rava expounded: a poker that broke may not be used to kindle on a Festival
Rava: for one kindles with vessels
Rava: and one does not kindle with broken vessels

supports.gloss_en: טעמא דחזי לאומצא, הא לא חזי לאומצא -- לא. למימרא דרבא כרבי יהודה סבירא ליה? -- the reason is that it is fit raw; were it not, no
הכי נמי מסתברא דרבא כרבי יהודה סבירא ליה, דדרש רבא: ... ואוד שנשבר אסור להסיקו ביום טוב ... שמע מינה
לפי שמסיקין בכלים ואין מסיקין בשברי כלים -- one kindles with vessels and not with broken vessels

objections.gloss_en: כמה חריפן שמעתתא דדרדקי! אימר דאמור רבנן בשוכח, לכתחילה מי אמור?! -- the device was permitted for one who forgot, not to be set up deliberately

answered_by.gloss_en: אי לאו דאדם חשוב אנא, כפא אכיפי למה לי? הא חזו למיזגא עלייהו -- the bundles are themselves fit to lean on; the spoon is only because I am an important person (= p_abaye_adam_chashuv, p_kifei_chazu_lemizga)

objections.gloss_en: אימר דאמור רבנן בשוכח, לכתחילה מי אמור?! -- the same rebuke, against Rava's knife on the dove

answered_by.gloss_en: אנא, אי לאו דאדם חשוב אנא -- סכינא אבר יונה למה לי? הא חזי לי לאומצא -- the dove is itself fit for me raw; the knife is only because I am an important person (= p_rava_adam_chashuv, p_bar_yona_chazi_leumtza)

objections.gloss_en: והאמר רבא לשמעיה: טווי לי בר אווזא ושדי מיעיה לשונרא -- Rava himself had the innards thrown to the cat

answered_by.gloss_en: התם כיון דמסרח, דעתיה עילויה מאתמול -- there, since it putrefies, his mind was on it from yesterday
